tweet_summary: Post shares a dramatic 'GoPro on a mountain goat' video of a goat traversing a sheer cliff, framed as real footage ('I hike small hills').
why_note_decision: The viral clip is AI-generated, not real animal-mounted GoPro footage. Fact-checks and the creator's own clarification confirm it was made with AI tools, and the goat's physically implausible horizontal cliff-running is a tell. Although several replies suspect it's AI, others treat it as real ('mesmerizing... I have watched this in person'), and it's posted by a 389k-follower account as genuine. Flagging synthetic media presented as real wildlife footage is the bot's core job, so a note is warranted (low stakes).
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states the video is AI-generated (synthetic), not real GoPro footage of a mountain goat — ideally noting the creator/fact-checkers confirmed its AI origin. The note may add that real goats do navigate steep terrain, but the core point is that THIS clip is artificial. A note that merely says 'looks unusual' or hedges without calling it AI is insufficient; FAIL any note that endorses it as authentic footage. Because the media itself is the deception, the note must rest on the AI determination, not on the (silent) AI description.
reference_note: This viral clip is AI-generated, not real GoPro footage of a mountain goat; the creator and fact-checkers have confirmed it was made with AI tools. Real goats do traverse steep terrain, but this specific video is synthetic. https://www.latestly.com/social-viral/fact-check/did-a-mountain-goat-trigger-the-collapse-of-dhaba-at-hill-station-in-north-india-fact-check-reveals-viral-reel-is-ai-generated-7234657.html https://www.instagram.com/reel/DSttuw4iEmb/

fact_check.claim_verdict: AI-generated: the 'goat GoPro cliff' clip is synthetic, confirmed by fact-checks and the creator; not authentic footage.
fact_check.notes: Fact-checkers attribute the clip to AI tools (Imagine Art) and a creator who makes AI wildlife content; the creator clarified its AI origin. The provided AI media description did NOT flag it as AI, so the verdict relies on web corroboration — exactly the case where the AI description can mislead. Borderline: AI-suspicion is voiced in replies, but synthetic-as-real wildlife is the canonical thing to flag, so I lean needs_note yes at low importance.

importance.lens_rationale: Only 34k impressions and low rating volume; harmless AI nature clip, but flagging AI-generated media presented as real has modest informational value.
